GRCh38.note: Approximate — between P4 and P2 per Skaletsky 2003. GRCh38 P1-P3 discordant with T2T-Y per Rhie 2023; P3 contains a known inversion vs T2T-Y.

CHM13.note: T2T-CHM13 v2.0/Y v1 — P3-left-arm 22760852-23044266 (283414 bp), P3-right-arm 23213315-23582346 (369031 bp), spacer 23044266-23213315 (~169 kb). Asymmetric arms reflect ampliconic insertions. Source: chm13v2.0Y_inverted_repeats_v1.bed (marbl).

copy_count_typical: 2 arms (palindromic, asymmetric due to amplicon mosaic)
architecture_note: P3 has the largest spacer (~169 kb) of P1-P5 and the lowest arm-to-arm identity (99.94%) — relatively older than P1/P2. Asymmetric arms in T2T-Y (left 283 kb, right 369 kb).

diagnostic_features.asymmetry_note: Right arm in T2T-Y is 369 kb vs left arm 283 kb — likely contains additional amplicon insertion(s) not present on left arm

primary.note: Identity 99.94% (slightly lower than P1/P2) → mm=2. Large spacer (~169 kb) is the strongest anchor.

fallback_chain.name: spacer_anchor
fallback_chain.trigger: primary returns ambiguous chains across both arms
fallback_chain.rationale: P3 spacer is large (~169 kb) — high probability that long reads span it

fallback_chain.name: asymmetry_check
fallback_chain.trigger: arm length matters for class assignment
fallback_chain.rationale: right-arm insertion present → assign right-arm; absent → left-arm

fallback_chain.name: novel_haplotype_flag
fallback_chain.rationale: Rhie 2023 documents a P3 inversion in GRCh38 — variant haplotypes possible

primary_sources.note: Skaletsky H et al., Nature. Table 3: P3 arm 283 kb, spacer 170 kb, identity 99.94%, total 736 kb.
Repping S et al., AJHG — P3 boundary of AZFb deletion.
Rhie A et al., Nature. P3 inversion confirmed in T2T-Y by Strand-seq; P3 discordant with GRCh38-Y.
